future_cases.expected_acceptance: Freeze three distinct artifact IDs; reject reordered, repeated, unknown or changed-prefix state; retain one summary per original ID.
Interrupt before/after content, descriptor and terminal write; observe retained bytes and correct job state; no duplicate effect.
Cancel queued/running/completed jobs and after crash between publication and acknowledgement; terminal states immutable and artifact retention explicit.
Test expired budget, backward/forward clock movement, reboot epoch, start limit and overlapping leases under chosen policy; account parent and worker resources.
Finite, empty, whole, disconnected and unknown sets; exact units/sign/horizon/sampling law; full response equality within common capability domain.
Distinguish malformed caller JSON, schema mismatch, wrong tool, invalid artifact, corrupt replay, worker failure and protocol failure; do not fabricate context for unparseable input.
Inject wrong context/units, nonfinite output and text/structured divergence on each adapter return path; explicit canonical validation required.
Change SDK, tool map, normalizer or launch profile under one idempotency key; preserve old evidence and require reviewed compatibility.
Real discovery result; unsupported-version error with common/no common version; other recognized modern error; two ordinary legacy error codes; timeout; modern-only refusal.
Malformed discovery/error shape, missing supported list, contradictory metadata and unknown mandatory fields; bounded refusal without coercing scientific semantics.
Bind era cache to server process/configuration; re-probe after changed assumptions; compare legacy and modern capability and response objects.
Unsupported optional extension reverts only where specified or rejects; independently reject incompatible operation/artifact/request schema.
Generated empty and partial receipts cannot establish adoption; retain missing owner and criterion identifiers.
Change each of reader/core/adapter/consumer/scientific context/platform; require an impact-reviewed exact successor or explicit scoped carry-forward.
An authentic verifier must check signer identity, authority, conflicts, evidence scope and unresolved conditions; local shape/hash success cannot do this.

known_remedies.anchor: Twelve explicit unresolved gaps and routes

comparison: Generated cases and permitted public inputs before expensive bank experiment; freeze expected semantics and failure origins first.

limits: Proposal requirement development only; no runtime repair or capability grant.
Saved generated local trials are rereviewed, not rerun or counted as fresh observations.
Exact finite models are authored references, not host failures, wire negotiation or authentic signatures.
General estimator recovery, complete dependency identity and distributed service guarantees remain unqualified.
Modern MCP support, typed replay errors, descriptor/FIFO repairs and complete consumer conformance remain open.
No bank truth, independent institutional review, consumer/platform adoption, actual prices or ROI is supplied.
Q1 coverage/depth, Q5 sponsor coherence and rendered visual acceptance remain open.
